description: September 17 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 3, birthday number 8, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 17 birthday falls in Virgo, in the third decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 8. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: The September 17 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Ambition with good manners describes one reading of September 17. Seventeen reduces to 8, numerology's number of authority and material results, while the Sun at roughly twenty-four degrees of Virgo sits in the Venus-ruled third decan, adding diplomacy and an instinct for presentation. Astrologers might picture someone who runs an orderly, attractive business and negotiates firmly without ever raising their voice.

Astronomically, September 17 puts the Sun near 24° Virgo in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Venus. Venus, ruler of Taurus, softens the last decan of Virgo, from roughly September 13 to September 22. The sign's practicality is joined by an eye for beauty, comfort and craft. Late-Virgo birthdays are often linked with gardening, design, cooking or any work where precision produces something pleasant to live with. Relationships may matter more than the classic Virgo stereotype suggests, and these natives tend to show love through thoughtful, tangible acts. Venus can encourage perfectionism about appearances too. Accepting that something can be lovely and unfinished at the same time usually brings this decan real ease.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for September 17
paragraphs: Born on the 17th, you have the compound 1 + 7 = 8 as your birthday number. The 1 brings ambition and drive, the 7 brings analysis and inner reflection, and together they feed the 8's practical authority. People born on this day are often described as strategic and independent, with good judgement about money, systems and long-term plans. They tend to think before they act, then act decisively. Read as a secondary number, the 17 is traditionally associated with quiet confidence and with achievement that comes from combining a clear vision with patient attention to detail.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a September 17 birthday gives Life Path 9 for 1990, 1 for 2000, 2 for 2010 and 3 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous September 17 birthdays
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 17 is the 260th day of the year (261st in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Libra, is usually complete within 6 days, by September 23.

By September 17 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a September 17 birthday are Narendra Modi (1950), Bernhard Riemann (1826) and Anastacia (1968).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 17?
faq.answer: September 17 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 17?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 17 the Life Path is 6 in 1960, 7 in 1970, 8 in 1980, 9 in 1990, 1 in 2000, 2 in 2010 and 3 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 8 for everyone born on the 17th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 17?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by September 17, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 17?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on September 17 include Narendra Modi (1950), Bernhard Riemann (1826) and Anastacia (1968). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
